scope: Source-confirmed integration members; optional and fallback branches are identified by source references, not claimed executed in every test. No new compatibility QI interfaces are advertised.

rows.purpose: URLs, WebSocket scheme normalization, tab reuse, request lookup
rows.generic_equivalent: Services.io.newURI represents a foreign URL truthfully; browser.currentURI already supplies a real UXP URI. No adapter or network ownership claim needed.
Reuse UXP URI parsing. Request method, original URI and source origin are separate facts, not inferred from URI.

rows.purpose: HTTP request/response and document observer registration
rows.generic_equivalent: Existing Gecko registrations must remain native. Generic API has no attributed per-request observation callback, and foreign documents cannot be supplied to Gecko DOM observers.

rows.purpose: Actual blocking, redirects, response CSP and size policy
rows.generic_equivalent: URI is representable, but a correct attributed cancellable request is absent. Observer rejects non-nsIHttpChannel immediately; advertising that interface with unsupported inherited semantics is not justified.

Declarative class predicates exist. Per-request resource type, frame identity and parent identity are not available from public send-request. Opaque contentAPI frame IDs cannot be correlated by URL/timing.
Known view can identify real XUL browser. associatedWindow must not be a fake foreign Gecko window; upstream request metadata/cancellable boundary still missing.

rows.purpose: Load context and docshell/window-utils/message manager retrieval
rows.generic_equivalent: Chrome services remain native. Foreign Gecko DOM/docshell interfaces cannot be advertised.

rows.purpose: Attach extension request data across observation/redirects
rows.generic_equivalent: A scoped project-owned request can carry properties, but there is no public attributed request lifetime/redirect event source for the required legacy flow.
Redirected response URL is exposed by WebProcess send-request; legacy old/new channel lifetimes, attributed IDs and response-control semantics are not supplied.
No equivalent async subresource policy deferral token is exposed by WPE send-request.

rows.purpose: Record pending frame/resource context, not final filtering
rows.generic_equivalent: Installed shouldLoad consumes contentWindow/ownerDocument/defaultView/top/parent/location and returns ACCEPT. Calling it with metadata alone does not run the network filter; fake Gecko DOM context would violate the task.

rows.purpose: HTTP sink and legacy content policy registration
rows.generic_equivalent: These register real Gecko observers/factories; no need to replace them.

rows.purpose: Discover native content policies and redirect sinks
rows.generic_equivalent: Native Gecko categories do not add a foreign per-request event source.
Extension factory remains native. No alternate interface advertised.

rows.purpose: Privileged global/browser message subscriptions and replies
rows.generic_equivalent: Serialized named async messages map to contentAPI, but existing listeners are reached through a Gecko frame loader requiring Components and Gecko windows. Blind broadcast into a shared foreign world lacks an extension principal/registration contract.

rows.purpose: Install location script and bootstrap already-open content
rows.generic_equivalent: All installed entry scripts use Components/import and Gecko docshell or content windows. They are not standards-DOM-plus-async-message scripts eligible for transparent injection.
Names/data/callbacks can map after an explicit portable bootstrap; obtaining this manager through foreign Gecko docshell/window chains cannot.

rows.purpose: Synchronous policy context and script-tag rule lookup
rows.generic_equivalent: No synchronous WebProcess IPC. Promise substitution changes the unchanged caller which immediately reads arrays/return values.

rows.purpose: Load privileged module and create content sandbox over a Gecko window
rows.generic_equivalent: Real isolated WebKit world exists. Cannot use it as a synchronous SpiderMonkey sandboxPrototype or expose Components to it.
Generic registerScript/executeScript supports supplied portable source. Discovering specific scripts by filename or extracting the extension closure would be identity/source-specific rewriting.
Opaque frame IDs and insertCSS/removeCSS are available; they do not justify fake window QI or synchronous foreign DOM access.
Real XUL browser identity can be retained; foreign docshell/DOM cannot be synthesized.

rows.purpose: Location message bootstrap and hidden background window load
rows.generic_equivalent: ContentEngineState has truthful URI/load state; unmodified listener bootstrap reads real DOMWindow and imports Gecko modules. Hidden chrome background remains native.
Generic location callback exists, but native DOM/window initialization blocks this legacy script. Do not fabricate a Gecko request/document.
browser.reload reaches selected view; browser.webNavigation is the native bookkeeping shell. Globally replacing its full XPCOM contract would affect unrelated chrome/extension consumers.
URI/title/selection/navigation already generic. Legacy messageManager and webNavigation remain actual native objects, not aliases for fake foreign docshells.
Chrome remains Gecko/XUL, independent of selected content engine.
Chrome timer remains native.
Unchanged UXP profile extension storage, not WebKit data.
Existing extension SQLite service remains native.
Unchanged privileged storage; no renderer duplication.
Unchanged chrome preferences.

rows.generic_equivalent: Unchanged privileged UXP service.

rows.generic_equivalent: Unchanged privileged UXP service.

rows.generic_equivalent: Unchanged privileged UXP service.

rows.generic_equivalent: Real WebKit DOM exists only inside the engine. No synchronous Gecko window proxy is permitted.
Existing native chrome lifetime/interface handling stays unchanged; alternate DOM/request callback subjects are not fabricated.
